usageLegend.DEFINED_BY: cell read 'Defined by ...' - container row, cardinality inherited from the parent

validatorSemantics.I: present is fine but NPHIES discards it

conventions.usage:
list of {usage,min,max,condition,rawUsage,rawMaxRpt}; a conditional cell such as 'M
(Report)
NP
(Order)' yields one entry per parallel position
conventions.hl7MaxRpt: the HL7 Max Rpt cell carries ONLY the max; min is derived from usage (M/R->1, R2/O/I/X/NP->0)
conventions.quote: verbatim non-empty cell texts of the row, joined with ' | '
conventions.role: data | structural | container | omit; null means the row carries no usage and no location (a grouping header)
conventions.tree: rows are flat in document order and carry num/parentNum/parentRowId/childRowIds; `tree` holds the nested skeleton {rowId,num,name,parentNum,children[]}
conventions.xdsMetadata: additive bucket (NOT part of the 3 core families): XDS/ITI document-metadata and stored-query tables

rows.guidance:
Definition: This field is the placer application's order number. This field ,combined with OBR-3 Filler Order Number, form the business identifier of the vital sign panel record. The source system must provide a unique value to identify the vital sign panel record and consistently refer to it in subsequent messages, such as Updates or Cancels.
It is recommended to assign the same number for OBR-2 and OBR-3.
· Element “Entity Identifier” SHALL be present
· Element “Universal ID” SHALL be set to the National Organization OID issued
Example: |BusinessId123^^2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.5.1.15000000112233|

Definition: This field identifies the provider who ordered the test. In the case of a vital signs record, this shall be set to the provider who obtained the vital sign reading.
· Element “ID Number” SHALL be set to the National Provider ID of the provider IF KNOWN
· Element “Family Name” SHALL be present IF KNOWN
o Sub-Element “Surname” SHALL be present and contain the family name
· Element “Given Name” SHALL be present IF KNOWN
· Element “Second and Further Given Names” SHALL be present IF KNOWN
· Element “Suffix” SHALL be present IF KNOWN
· Element “Prefix” SHALL be present IF KNOWN
· Element “Assigning Authority” SHALL be set to the National Provider Directory OID with the following sub-elements:
o Sub-Element “Universal ID” SHALL be set to “2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.2.1”
nphies only stores the first repeat of this field!

Definition: This field uniquely identifies the patient’s pre-admit account. Some systems will continue to use the pre-admit number as the billing number after the patient has been admitted. For backward compatibility, a ST data type can be sent; however HL7 recommends use of the CX data type, like the account number, for new implementations. The assigning authority and identifier type codes are strongly recommended for all CX data types.
· Element “ID Number” MAY be present
· Element “Assigning Authority” MAY be present
o Element “Universal ID” MAY be set to the National Organization OID issued.
o Element “Universal ID Type” MAY be set to “ISO”
· Element “Identifier Type Code” MAY be present
Example: |PreadmitNum6394^^^ &2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.5.1.15000000112233&ISO|

rows.guidance:
Definition: For backward compatibility, a NM data type may be sent, but HL7 recommends that new implementations use the CX data type. This field contains the unique number assigned to each patient visit. The assigning authority and identifier type code are strongly recommended for all CX data types.
Used to link the encounter-related information.
The source system must provide a unique value to identify the encounter and consistently refer to it in subsequent messages, such as Updates or Cancels.
· Element “ID Number” SHALL be present
· Element “Assigning Authority” SHALL be present
o Sub-Element “Universal ID” SHALL be set to National Organization OID
o Sub-Element “Universal ID Type” SHALL be set to “ISO”
· Element “Identifier Type Code” MAY be present
Example: |VisNum53674^^^ &2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.5.1.15000000112233&ISO|

o Sub-Element “Universal ID” SHALL be set to National Organization OID

Definition: This field contains the format of the observation value in OBX.

Code
Description
NM
Numeric
ST
String Data.

source.quote:

rows.guidance:
Definition: This field contains a unique identifier for the observation.
· Element “Identifier” SHALL be set to a value from the below table, column “Code”
· Element “Text” SHALL be set to a value from the below table, column “Description”

rows.guidance:
Definition: When an observation’s value is measured on a continuous scale, one must report the measurement units within the units field of the OBX segment.
This field SHALL contain a value out of vital signs units value set.
· Below element “Identifier” shall be set to the corresponding UCUM unit if indicated:
· Other element “Identifier” SHALL be set to a code out of the “KSA Laboratory Observation Units” value set IF KNOWN.
· Element “Text” MAY be set to a description out of the “KSA Laboratory Observation Units” value set.
· Element “Name Of Coding System” MAY be set to “2.16.840.1.113883.6.8”
Example: |{beats}/min|

rows.guidance:
Definition: This field uniquely identifies the sending application among all other applications within the network enterprise. The network enterprise consists of all those applications that participate in the exchange of HL7 messages within the enterprise. Entirely site-defined.
· Element “Namespace ID” SHALL NOT be present
· Element “Universal ID” SHALL be set to the National Organization OID issued.
· Element “Universal ID Type” SHALL be set to “ISO”
Format of the National Organization OID:
2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.XXXX
The National Organization OID is composed like in the format above, where XXXX is the nphies assigned OID extension that includes the organization identifier value out of the KSA-Wide Healthcare Provider Directory.

rows.name: Duration of Treatment
rows.guidance:
The “Duration of Treatment” period SHALL be present.
In case of complex Dosage Instruction scenarios (e.g., tapered dosage, etc.), this element SHALL span over the maximum durations of all Dosage Instruction components.
It SHALL correspond to the value for “Overall duration of treatment” in the parent (MedicationRequest or MedicationDispense).
The Duration of Treatment can be provided in 2 different formats:
“Period” format:
Both start and end date SHALL be present.
“Duration” format:
The duration value SHALL be present.
The duration code SHALL be present and come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set (Code).
The duration unit SHALL be present and come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set (Concept Name).

rows.guidance:
Each dosageInstruction element contains the information of one specific intake “component” during the fixed period “per day”.
Example: Intake regime 2-0-1-0 results into 2 dosageInstruction elements (= components), one representing the morning dose (2 tablets) and one the evening dose (1 tablet).

rows.elementLocationRaw:
Element depending on DT of “Type”:
./valueCodeableConcept (DT = Code)
or
./valueQuantity (DT = Qty)
Or

rows.guidance:
The value of the Additional Order Information.
Which variant of the value[x] element depends on the datatype (DT) of the “Additional Order Information – Type”
The value itself also depends on the “Additional Order Information – Type”:
In case of “Preexisting condition” or “Risk factors”
Element: valueCodeableConcept
The code and display sub-elements SHALL contain a value out of the “Principal Diagnosis” Value Set.
The system sub-element SHALL contain the OID urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.6.135
In case of “Current Chronological Age”
Element: valueQuantity
The value sub-element SHALL contain the age
The unit sub-element SHALL be set out of the “KSA Time Units” value-set.
In case of “Body Height Measure”
Element: valueQuantity
The value sub-element SHALL contain the body height.
The unit sub-element SHALL be set out of the “KSA Height Units” value-set.
In case of “Body Weight Measure”
Element: valueQuantity
The value sub-element SHALL contain the body weight.
The unit sub-element SHALL be set out of the “KSA Weight Units” value-set.
In case of “Pregnancy” or “Lactation”
Element: valueBoolean
If active: The value is set to true
If inactive: The value is set to false

rows.name: Status
rows.guidance:
Status of the Prescription Item SHALL be present and SHALL be out of the FHIR Medication Request Status value-set.
The following values are allowed for the code element:
code
Definition
active
Prescription Item is not fully dispensed (this value has also to be set to resume a prescription after “on-hold”)
on-hold
Prescription Item is suspended
completed
Prescription Item is fully dispensed
cancelled
Prescription Item is cancelled before any dispensations have occurred
stopped
Prescription Item is stopped, after dispensation(s) already occurred, but before all of the dispensations occurred.

rows.name: Overarching Prescription Id
rows.guidance:
The identifier of the Prescription, holding together this Prescription Item with others.
All Prescription Items belonging to one prescription share the same groupIdentifier.
The system sub-element SHALL be set to an OID assigned by Health Information Exchange at deployment time to each system issuing Prescription Items to ensure a unique identifier.
The value sub-element SHALL contain the unique identifier within the system OID.
Note: A new groupIdentifier (National Reference ID) will be assigned by the central system at the time of first submission for all medication types. This identifier will be used as the reference in all subsequent actions submitted.
See here

rows.name: Number of repeats/refills
rows.guidance:
The repeatNumber element SHALL be present, and SHALL contain the number of allowed repeats/refills of the Prescription Item.
If the repeatNumber element has a value of zero, no repeat/refill is allowed (single dispense).
The total number of dispenses will be thus equal to the repeat number plus one.
In case that the Prescription Item Type is ‘Controlled/narcotic” prescription, No repeats/refills are allowed and thus this element SHALL be set to value 0 (zero).

The total number of dispenses will be thus equal to the repeat number plus one.
In case that the Prescription Item Type is ‘Controlled/narcotic” prescription, No repeats/refills are allowed and thus this element SHALL be set to value 0 (zero).

rows.name: Amount of units of the medication to be dispensed
rows.guidance:
The “Amount of units of the consumable” to be dispensed element describes the quantity of the Medicinal Product (Medicine) prescribed.
The unit sub-element SHALL be out of the “KSA Medication Quantity Unit” value-set.
The unit sub-element SHALL correspond to one of the following:
The Pharmaceutical Dose Form of the Generic
The unit of the strength (only possible, if there is only 1 active substance)
The Package Form (only possible, if a specific product is requested)
Examples:
250ml (if the Pharmaceutical Dose Form is “solution”)
100mg (if the strength of the medication is in mg, e.g. 25mg)
3 (if a product is requested with Package Form “bottle”)

rows.name: Overall duration of treatment
rows.guidance:
The overall duration of treatment SHALL be provided and correspond to the duration in the Dosage Instructions.
In case of complex Dosage Instruction scenarios (e.g., tapered dosage, etc.), this element SHALL span over the maximum durations of all Dosage Instruction components.
The duration value SHALL be present.
The duration code SHALL be present and come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set (Code).
The duration unit SHALL be present and come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set (Concept Name)
See here

rows.name: Duration of Component
rows.guidance:
The “Duration of Component” period SHALL be present to indicate the duration of this component of the treatment.
It is represented as period, where both start and end SHALL be present.
It SHALL be lower or equal to the value of “Duration of Treatment” in the “Dosage Instructions General”. The total duration of all components SHALL be equal to the value in “Duration of Treatment” (see section 2.7.3.6.4).
The Duration of Component can be provided in 2 different formats:
“Period” format:
Both start and end date SHALL be present.
“Duration” format:
The duration value SHALL be present.
The duration code SHALL be present and come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set (Code).
The duration unit SHALL be present and come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set (Concept Name).

rows.name: Endpoint Address
rows.guidance:
The technical base address for connecting to this endpoint.
It SHALL contain the base address of the endpoint. The base address is the address, on top of which WADO or WADO-RS GET requests are formulated.
Example for base endpoint: https://pacs.hospital.org/wado-rs-endpoint
Example WADO-RS request for retrieving the entire study 1.2.3.4 from this endpoint: https://pacs.hospital.org/wado-rs-endpoint/studies/1.2.3.4/
Example WADO-RS request for retrieving the series 5.6.7.8 from study 1.2.3.4: https://pacs.hospital.org/wado-rs-endpoint/studies/1.2.3.4/series/5.6.7.8/
For the DICOM Web Services standard see https://dicom.nema.org/medical/dicom/current/output/chtml/part18/PS3.18.html
Additional information on WADO-RS DICOMweb requests, see https://www.dicomstandard.org/using/dicomweb

rows.name: Business identifier of the Prescription Item
rows.guidance:
A Prescription Item Id SHALL be present.
The system sub-element SHALL be set to an OID assigned by Health Information Exchange at deployment time to each system issuing Prescription Items to ensure a unique identifier.
The value sub-element SHALL contain the unique identifier within the system OID.
Note: This id is used to semantically link dispenses to that prescription item!

rows.name: Number of repeats/refills
rows.guidance:
The repeatNumber element SHALL be present, and SHALL contain the number of allowed repeats/refills of the Prescription Item.
If the repeatNumber element has a value of zero no repeat/refill is allowed (single dispense).
The total number of dispenses will be thus equal to the repeat number plus one.

rows.name: Amount of units of the medication to be dispensed
rows.guidance:
The “Amount of units of the consumable” to be dispensed element describes the quantity of the Medicinal Product (Medicine) prescribed.
The unit sub-element SHALL be out of the “KSA Medication Quantity Unit” value-set.
The unit sub-element SHALL correspond to one of the following:
The Pharmaceutical Dose Form of the Generic.
The unit of the strength (only possible, if there is only 1 active substance).
The Package Form (only possible, if a specific product is requested).
Examples:
250ml (if the Pharmaceutical Dose Form is “solution”).
100mg (if the strength of the medication is in mg, e.g. 25mg).
3 (if a product is requested with Package Form “bottle”).

source.quote:
2.24 | Amount of units of the medication to be dispensed | M | [1..1] | ./dispenseRequest/quantity | The “Amount of units of the consumable” to be dispensed element describes the quantity of the Medicinal Product (Medicine) prescribed.
The unit sub-element SHALL be out of the “KSA Medication Quantity Unit” value-set.
The unit sub-element SHALL correspond to one of the following:
The Pharmaceutical Dose Form of the Generic.
The unit of the strength (only possible, if there is only 1 active substance).
The Package Form (only possible, if a specific product is requested).
Examples:
250ml (if the Pharmaceutical Dose Form is “solution”).
100mg (if the strength of the medication is in mg, e.g. 25mg).
3 (if a product is requested with Package Form “bottle”).

rows.name: Overall duration of treatment
rows.guidance:
The overall duration of treatment SHALL be provided and correspond to the duration in the Dosage Instructions.
In case of complex Dosage Instruction scenarios (e.g., tapered dosage, etc.), this element SHALL span over the maximum durations of all Dosage Instruction components.
The duration unit SHALL come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set.
See “Structured Dosage Instructions”

The duration unit SHALL come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set.
See “Structured Dosage Instructions”

rows.name: Performing Time Period
rows.guidance:
In case this observation describes a single Laboratory Test, then the end datetime of the period reported SHALL be set to the datetime the result of that test was determined.
In case this observation describes a group/battery of tests and contains the actual lab observations as “hasMember”, the following constraints apply:
· The start sub-element SHALL contain the earliest start-date of all lab observations within the group.
· The end sub-element SHALL contain the latest end-date of all lab observations within the group.
It SHALL be recorded in the greatest precision available.
The datetime sub-elements SHALL contain the date, time and time zone in format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+zz:zz
Example:

Otherwise the Performing Time Period SHALL NOT be present (e.g., in test groups).

rows.name: Observation Value
rows.guidance:
The observation value represents a quantitative or qualitative measurement result.
This element SHALL be present, unless the observation.code element represents a panel/battery code, and observation.hasMember element is present to report grouped observations, in which case this element SHALL NOT be present.
Element: Data Type Allowed
valueQuantity: Quantity
valueCodeableConcept: CodeableConcept
valueString: string
valueBoolean: boolean
valueInteger: integer
valueRange: Range
valueRatio: Ratio
If the datatype of the value contains a unit (Quantity, Range or Ratio) the unit SHALL be out of the “KSA Laboratory Observation Units” value set.
Test/analysis being still in progress
In case of a test/analysis being still in progress and thus an “incomplete result” a coded value @code=’255599008’ out of @system=‘2.16.840.1.113883.6.96’ (SNOMED CT) SHALL be present.
No result
In case of “no result because of insufficient sample” a coded value @code=‘281268007’ out of @system=‘2.16.840.1.113883.6.96’ (SNOMED CT) SHALL be present.

valueBoolean: boolean
valueInteger: integer
valueRange: Range
valueRatio: Ratio
If the datatype of the value contains a unit (Quantity, Range or Ratio) the unit SHALL be out of the “KSA Laboratory Observation Units” value set.
Test/analysis being still in progress
In case of a test/analysis being still in progress and thus an “incomplete result” a coded value @code=’255599008’ out of @system=‘2.16.840.1.113883.6.96’ (SNOMED CT) SHALL be present.
No result
In case of “no result because of insufficient sample” a coded value @code=‘281268007’ out of @system=‘2.16.840.1.113883.6.96’ (SNOMED CT) SHALL be present.

rows.name: Chief Complaint
rows.guidance:
The Chief Complaint is free text subjective statement made by a patient describing the most significant or serious symptoms or signs of illness or dysfunction that caused him or her to seek healthcare.
See Chief Complaint Section

Hospital Admission Diagnosis
(Pre-Diagnosis)
rows.guidance:
The Admitting Diagnosis contains a description of the primary reason for the encounter.
See Hospital Admission Diagnosis Section (Problem List)

source.quote:
5 | Hospital Admission Diagnosis

rows.guidance:

(Maternal History)
rows.guidance:

See Pregnancy History Section

rows.guidance:
The allergies and other adverse reactions section shall contain a narrative description of the substance intolerances and the associated adverse reactions suffered by the patient. It shall include entries for intolerances and adverse reactions as described in the Entry Content Modules.
See Allergies and Adverse Reactions Section

See Allergies and Adverse Reactions Section

rows.guidance:

This section records additional diagnosis to the ones recorded in the Reason for Referral section.

(Mode of Delivery and Delivery Outcomes)

rows.name: Duration of Treatment
rows.guidance:
An effectiveTime element SHALL be present to record the Duration of the Medication Treatment with attribute xsi:type=’IVL_TS’ present to type-cast it to a time interval.
A low sub-element SHALL be present to indicate the start of the medication treatment. If the start of the medication treatment is unknown, @nullFlavor=’UNK’ SHALL be used.
A high sub-element SHALL be present to indicate the end of the medication treatment. If the end of the medication treatment is unknown, @nullFlavor=’UNK’ SHALL be used.
Duration units of both low and high sub-elements SHALL come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set.
In case the Duration of Treatment is entirely unknown the effectiveTime element SHALL contain a @nullFlavor attribute set to ‘NA’ and the low and high sub-elements SHALL be set to @nullFlavor=’UNK’.

A high sub-element SHALL be present to indicate the end of the medication treatment. If the end of the medication treatment is unknown, @nullFlavor=’UNK’ SHALL be used.
Duration units of both low and high sub-elements SHALL come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set.

rows.name: Preoperative Diagnosis Section
rows.guidance:
The Preoperative Diagnosis Section contains the surgical diagnosis or diagnoses assigned to the patient before a surgical procedure and is the reason for the surgery. The preoperative diagnosis is, in the opinion of the surgeon, the diagnosis that will be confirmed during surgery.
This section is an adaptation of the HL7 C-CDA Preoperative Diagnosis Section template.
Note: “Adaptation” means that it’s “based on”, but not fully compliant with the underlying base template.

source.quote:
28 | Preoperative Diagnosis Section | Defined by document type | ./component/section | The Preoperative Diagnosis Section contains the surgical diagnosis or diagnoses assigned to the patient before a surgical procedure and is the reason for the surgery. The preoperative diagnosis is, in the opinion of the surgeon, the diagnosis that will be confirmed during surgery.
This section is an adaptation of the HL7 C-CDA Preoperative Diagnosis Section template.

rows.guidance:

rows.name: Duration of Treatment
rows.guidance:
A first effectiveTime element SHALL be present to record the Duration of the Medication Treatment with attribute xsi:type=’IVL_TS’ present to type-cast it to a time interval.
If the “Delayed Start Dosing” templateId is NOT present:
A low sub-element SHALL be present to indicate the start of the medication treatment. If the start of the medication treatment is unknown, @nullFlavor=’UNK’ SHALL be used.
A high sub-element SHALL be present to indicate the end of the medication treatment. If the end of the medication treatment is unknown, @nullFlavor=’UNK’ SHALL be used.
If the “Delayed Start Dosing” templateId is present:
A width element SHALL be present instead of a low and high element.
Duration units of low, high and width sub-elements SHALL come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set.
In case the Duration of Treatment is entirely unknown the effectiveTime element SHALL contain a @nullFlavor attribute set to ‘NA’ and the low and high sub-elements SHALL be set to @nullFlavor=’UNK’.

rows.name: Medication Frequency
rows.guidance:
The second <effectiveTime> element records the frequency of administration of the dose (specified in element doseQuantity).
An attribute @xsi:type=’PIVL_TS’ SHALL be present.
An attribute @operator=’A’ SHALL be present.
An attribute @institutionSpecified=’true’ SHALL be present. Note: This attribute states, that the exact timing event is determined by the party executing the schedule.
The Medication Frequency is expressed in the period sub-element, with the attributes @value representing the frequency and @unit representing the period within the frequency occurs
Example: “2 times” (@value) per “day” (@unit).
Frequency units SHALL come out of the “KSA Medication Duration Unit” value-set.
Note: This <effectiveTime> element is intersected with the previous time specification (operator='A'), producing the bounded set containing only those time specifications that fall within the start and stop time of the medication regimen.

rows.name: Newborn Screening Observation Value
rows.guidance:
The observation value represents a quantitative or qualitative measurement result.
The element needs to be casted to the datatype. Allowed <datatypes> for the value are “Data Types” Value Set.
If the datatype of the value contains a unit (PQ or IVL_PQ) the unit SHALL be out of the “KSA Laboratory Observation Units” value set.
The narrative expression of this value SHALL contain the value and unit as stated in this element and SHOULD contain an additional explanation of the unit according to the description column of the unit (for complex units).
See the following examples:
<value xsi:type=’PQ’ value=’10’ unit=’mg’/>
10 mg (milligram)
<value xsi:type=’PQ’ value=’1’ unit=’{CAG_repeats}’/>
1 {CAG_repeats} (CAG trinucleotide repeats)
<value xsi:type=’PQ’ value=’5’ unit=’{CAG_repeats}’/>
5 10*9/mL (billion per milliliter)

rows.guidance:
The observation value represents a quantitative or qualitative measurement result.
The element needs to be casted to the datatype. Allowed <datatypes> for the value are “Data Types” Value Set.
If the datatype of the value contains a unit (PQ or IVL_PQ) the unit SHALL be out of the “KSA Laboratory Observation Units” value set.
The narrative expression of this value SHALL contain the value and unit as stated in this element and SHOULD contain an additional explanation of the unit according to the description column of the unit (for complex units).

10 mg (milligram)
<value xsi:type=’PQ’ value=’1’ unit=’{CAG_repeats}’/>
1 {CAG_repeats} (CAG trinucleotide repeats)
<value xsi:type=’PQ’ value=’5’ unit=’{CAG_repeats}’/>
5 10*9/mL (billion per milliliter)

rows.name: Observation Code
rows.guidance:
This is a code and a description of the test result. The code may be the same value as the test ordered and/or test performed, or it can be different when the result is for a panel or profile (e.g., one result of several produced by a single test).
SHALL contain a value out of the “KSA Laboratory Orders and Results” Value Set.
The element SHALL use a “originalText/reference” sub-element to point to the narrative expression in the section’s text-element.
Note: The “KSA Laboratory Orders and Results” Value Set uses codes from LOINC. Participants may choose to request codes be included during the onboarding process to support coding of results.

rows.name: Observation Status Code (Business/workflow level)
rows.guidance:
The status of Laboratory Test in the context of the workflow / business process (e.g., preliminary, final, corrected, …) SHALL be present IF KNOWN. If this element is omitted, the value “final” is assumed.
SHALL contain one of the following values out of the “nphies FHIR Observation Status” Value Set.
The value must not contradict the value set in the prior statusCode element.
Note: this is the more comprehensive status of that observation on the layer of workflow and process.

If this element is omitted, the value “final” is assumed.
SHALL contain one of the following values out of the “nphies FHIR Observation Status” Value Set.
The value must not contradict the value set in the prior statusCode element.
Note: this is the more comprehensive status of that observation on the layer of workflow and process.

rows.name: Observation Value
rows.guidance:
The observation value represents a quantitative or qualitative measurement result.
The element needs to be casted to the datatype. Allowed <datatypes> for the value are “Data Types” value Set.
If the datatype of the value contains a unit (PQ or IVL_PQ) the unit SHALL be out of the “KSA Laboratory Observation Units” value set.
The narrative expression of this value SHALL contain the value and unit as stated in this element and SHOULD contain an additional explanation of the unit according to the description column of the unit (for complex units).
See the following examples:
<value xsi:type=’PQ’ value=’10’ unit=’mg’/>
10 mg (milligram)
<value xsi:type=’PQ’ value=’1’ unit=’{CAG_repeats}’/>
1 {CAG_repeats} (CAG trinucleotide repeats)
<value xsi:type=’PQ’ value=’5’ unit=’{CAG_repeats}’/>
5 10*9/mL (billion per milliliter)
Test/analysis being still in progress
In case of a test/analysis being still in progress and thus an “incomplete result” a coded value @code=’255599008’ out of @codeSystem=‘2.16.840.1.113883.6.96’ (SNOMED CT) SHALL be present.
No result
In case of “no result because of insufficient sample” a coded value @code=‘281268007’ out of @codeSystem=‘2.16.840.1.113883.6.96’ (SNOMED CT) SHALL be present.

rows.guidance:
The Reference Range Value SHALL be present IF KNOWN.
The element needs to be casted to the datatype. Allowed <datatypes> for the value are (DT 4 & 6 & 8.) of the “Data Types“ value Set.
If the datatype of the value contains a unit (IVL_PQ) the unit SHALL be out of the “KSA Laboratory Observation Units” value set.
The narrative expression of this value SHALL contain the value and MAY contain the unit as stated in this element.
If the unit is present it SHOULD contain an additional explanation of the unit according to the description column of the unit (for complex units).

rows.guidance:
History general describes all aspects of medical history of the patient even if not pertinent to the current procedure, and may include chief complaint, past medical history, social history, family history, surgical or procedure history, medication history, and other history information. rows.name: referenceIdList
rows.guidance:
In case of the document submitted is in CDA format: The first referencedIdList entry SHALL be set to the CDA element ClinicalDocument/setId:
<@extension>^^^&<@root>&ISO^urn:ksa-ehealth:document:setId:2023
Additional internal or external identifiers may be present.
E.g., Identifiers may be Accession Numbers, Order Numbers, Referral Request Identifiers, XDW Workflow Instance Identifiers, etc.
The element is of datatype CXi, which require the presence of an URN to define the type of the identifier.
Only URNs specified by IHE are allowed:
urn:ihe:iti:xds:2013:uniqueId
urn:ihe:iti:xds:2013:accession
urn:ihe:iti:xds:2013:referral
urn:ihe:iti:xds:2013:order
urn:ihe:iti:xdw:2013:workflowInstanceId
urn:ihe:iti:xds:2016:studyInstanceUID
urn:ihe:iti:xds:2015:encounterId
Note: More constraints on this information element may be defined in specific document types.
Please refer to the IHE ITI Technical Framework Volume 3, chapter 4.2.3.1.7, Table 4.2.3.1.7-2: Datatypes, CXi datatype for a list of defined URNs for such identifiers.
See IHE TF for details: 4.2.3.2.28

rows.name: serviceStartTime
rows.guidance:
Represents the start time the service being documented took place (clinically significant, but not necessarily when the document was produced or approved).
MAY be derived from CDA element ClinicalDocument/documentationOf/serviceEvent/effectiveTime/low
Note:
if more than one documentationOf element is present, the “minimum” of the time in the low elements may be calculated to determine the “overall” start time.
if no documentationOf element is present, or none of the present ones contains an effectiveTime element, this metadata element SHALL NOT be present.
SHALL be provided in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), timezone conversion may be required!
See IHE TF for details: 4.2.3.2.19
